contributions.detail: FORM A IS BLANK WHILE THE COVER REPORTS 1521 CUMULATIVE - an honest internal inconsistency of the filer's, and the reason the side is 'transcribed' with zero rows rather than a delta. Form A (p2) carries no ink on any ruled band and no strike-out. Cover line 1 reads '1521.' (whole dollars, trailing period, no cents written) in BOTH the LAST-REPORT and the CUMULATIVE column, with the THIS-REPORT cell a bare dash = blank; line 2 is a bare dash in all three columns. Read literally the filer is saying no NEW over-$50 contributions came in this period, and the 1521 was itemised on an earlier filing not present in this document. But the SAME filer itemised his expenditures CUMULATIVELY here, back to 2009 (see the expenditures side), so his two schedules are on different scopes and the contribution itemisation for the 1521 exists nowhere in this document. No row set can be scored against any printed figure, so result is unknown and no sum is claimed. NOTHING was borrowed from another filing.
contributions.note_on_zero: The blank cells here are bare DASHES, not zero glyphs, so they stay BLANK - they are not zeros.

expenditures.detail: Twenty Form B rows dated 3/15/2009 through 9/7/2012 sum to EXACTLY 1267.00 = the cover's only printed line-3 figure, '1,267.' in the CUMULATIVE column (the LAST and THIS cells are empty). The rows span the whole four-year term, so this schedule is unambiguously cycle-cumulative. The sum is also what proves the field-shift reading at the top of the page (see page_subtotal_gates and the row notes): only by assigning the 50.00 on band 3 to the 4/19/09 Cash row and the 150.00 on band 4 to the 6/18/09 NFIB row does the schedule close.

gates.row_count: p3 has ~23 inked bands but only 20 TRANSACTIONS - three bands are purpose-text WRAPS carrying no date, payee or amount ('travel, etc.' for the 4/19/09 Cash row, 'meals etc.' for the 5/11/10 Cash row, 'meals, office exp.' for the 12/1/11 Cash row), and a further three bands at the foot carry the filer's free-text 'Note: All travel exp. listed is unreimbursed travel in county.' which is not a transaction and was not emitted. Counted by eye against ink at 200 dpi, then confirmed on four 1200 dpi amount-column strips: exactly 20 amounts are written in the amount column, and the band below the last one renders empty. p2: 0 inked bands -> 0 rows.

gates.balance_chain: CLOSES EXACTLY on the cumulative column: 1521 (line 1) - 1267 (line 3) = 254 = cover line 4 balance '254.'. This is the check that makes the blank Form A legible as a filer omission rather than a mis-scan: the cover's own arithmetic requires the 1521 of contributions that the document never itemises. No earlier filing by this filer is in this chunk, so no cross-filing chain was available.

notes: FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN FIRED AND WAS RESOLVED AT THE PAGE (core brief 3(e)). At the top of Form B the filer's rows and the ruled bands do not line up: band 2 holds '4/19/09 | Cash | Petty Cash-postage' with an EMPTY amount cell; band 3 holds '6/18/09 | NFIB' in the payee column but 'travel, etc.' in the purpose column - the WRAP of the Cash row's purpose - and the amount 50.00, which belongs to the Cash row; band 4 holds no date and no payee, the purpose 'Membership dues' and the amount 150.00, and the filer drew a long arrow from 'NFIB' on band 3 across to 'Membership dues' on band 4 to say so explicitly. Transcribed as two transactions (Cash 50.00, NFIB 150.00), which is what the arrow says AND what makes the schedule sum to the printed 1,267. Cover reads 'Craig W Buttars' (index.csv 'C Buttars' - agrees), office line verbatim 'Cache County Council', Office District 'North', signed 10/30/12, stamped RCVD 30 OCT 2012 - a county office, in scope, agreeing with the chunk date 2012-10. Every amount on p3 is written whole-dollars with a raised '00' over the decimal. A tick mark appears in the right margin beside 17 of the 20 rows (all but the last two and one other) - a checking mark, not a form field, and not transcribed. Candidate street address, ZIP and cell phone on the cover were discarded at read time.
